aui design system

33 cards

Composer

  • Composer (dark) Auto-growing input, meta strip, actions menu, model and mode pickers, send/stop morph, queued messages
  • Composer (light) Auto-growing input, meta strip, actions menu, model and mode pickers, send/stop morph, queued messages
  • Slash commands and mentions Inline / menu with sections and keyboard hints; @ picker for files, symbols, worktrees; $ skills
  • Attachments and drop Image thumbs, file rows with upload states, drop overlay over the transcript, paste hint

Foundations

  • Colour Semantic tokens, agent states, diff and terminal palettes in both themes
  • Typography Geist for UI, Geist Mono for code and terminals; scale 11–24
  • Spacing, radius, elevation 2/4/8/12/16/24/32 · radii 4–16 · three shadow levels
  • Motion Durations, easings and the four springs; live samples
  • Icons and marks Lucide-style 14/16 px glyphs, provider marks, status glyphs, file types

Shell

  • App shell Three columns, each with its own header row; sidebar, transcript, workbench; status bar
  • Panel chrome and tabs Tab strip with sliding indicator, panel header, drag-to-dock drop zones
  • Command palette ⌘K with sections, fuzzy matches, shortcut hints; quick open ⌘P
  • Toasts and banners Stacked toasts, newest in front; inline banners for waiting, context, provider and connection states

Sidebar

  • Worktree rows Every state: running, needs you, done with PR, failed, idle, selected, hover actions, child tasks
  • Sidebar Header, primary nav, collapsible groups with counts, filters, account footer, and the collapsed rail
  • Assistant sidebar Roles → projects → sessions, with knowledge sources per role and recent documents
  • Sidebar views Three groupings of the same sessions: by status, by project with nested sessions, by date; plus the view-options menu

Transcript

  • Header identity and markers The agent mark and worktree live in the centre header cell; model and mode in the composer; marker rows inside the transcript
  • User and assistant turns User bubble with attachments and mentions; assistant turn streaming with reveal, hover toolbar and footer meta
  • Thinking block Shimmer label with elapsed time, capped streaming viewport, collapses to a summary when done
  • Agent activity group Consecutive tool calls fold into one summary row with a step timeline; live state while working
  • Tool call cards Shell, read, edit, search, web and browser variants with the shared header: status, verb, target, duration
  • Approval card Permission request: pending, approving, approved, denied, remembered; keyboard Y / A / N
  • Question, plan and todo cards Single and multi-select questions with Other; plan proposal with accept/edit; todo list with morphing marks
  • Code and diff blocks Inline code block with header actions and copy morph; unified diff block with per-line note affordance
  • Summary, error and status rows Turn summary with changed files and PR CTA; error card with retry; working line, needs-you banner, jump-to-latest

Workbench

  • Terminal Block terminal: each command is a card with status, duration and foldable output; agent commands are tagged; splits and tabs
  • Browser and annotator Tabs and nav; annotate mode pins numbered comments on elements, lists them beside the page, and sends the batch with metadata and a screenshot to the agent
  • Diff review Scope switch, file list with change counts, unified diff with hunks, batched line notes sent back to an agent
  • Git and pull request Changes list, AI-drafted commit, ahead/behind, Create PR form with base branch and checks
  • File tree and document panes (dark) Worktree-aware file explorer with git badges; assistant document pane chrome for docx, xlsx, pdf and markdown with chat-created artifacts
  • File tree and document panes (light) Worktree-aware file explorer with git badges; assistant document pane chrome for docx, xlsx, pdf and markdown with chat-created artifacts
  • Sources and citations Assistant answer with inline citation markers, sources list grouped by tier (role, project, session), and a source hover card
